name: How long does kitchen cabinet installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The physical installation of kitchen cabinets generally takes between two and four days for an average kitchen. The timeline depends heavily on the kitchen size, wall straightness, and whether your layout includes standard modular boxes or custom trim. Before hanging cabinets, framing must be plumb, drywall must be finished, and rough-in plumbing and electrical adjustments must be completed. If your remodel involves moving sink lines or appliance outlets, coordinating those trades adds time prior to cabinet delivery. Custom crown molding, scribe molding along uneven walls, and decorative end panels are detailed finish carpentry tasks completed at the end of the installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet installation usually takes two to four days, depending on kitchen size, framing conditions, and trim complexity.
